expected_title: Improving Traffic Forecasting for 5G Core Network Scalability: A Machine Learning Approach
summary: Proposes scaling 5G core VNF resources proactively by forecasting the traffic load with neural networks instead of reacting to utilisation thresholds.
method: LSTM and DNN load forecasting driving proactive VNF scale-out/in
key_result: Forecast-driven scaling reacts faster to load changes and has new resources ready earlier than threshold-based scaling.
limitation_or_critique: Pre-SBA-maturity study evaluated in simulation only, with a single forecast target and no per-NF (AMF/SMF) procedure model or cost of scaling.

expected_title: Smart Scaling of the 5G Core Network: An RNN-Based Approach
summary: Uses recurrent neural networks to predict upcoming control- and data-plane load of a virtualised 5G core and schedules scale-out and scale-in ahead of demand.
method: RNN load forecasting with proactive provisioning schedule
data_or_testbed: discrete-event simulation with an operator traffic trace
key_result: The forecast-based scaler is reported to be more robust than threshold-based scaling in keeping QoS during load increases.
limitation_or_critique: Simulation-only evaluation that treats the core as a generic VNF pool, without real NF implementations or failure scenarios.

summary: Discusses how orchestrators should place and scale 5G core functions per network slice to meet slice SLOs on shared infrastructure, and argues for AI-driven, functionality-aware placement and scaling.
method: position/design article with AI-driven scaling coupled to NF-aware placement
data_or_testbed: illustrative evaluation (no public dataset reported in the abstract)
key_result: Argues qualitatively that coupling learned scaling with awareness of each core function's role lets providers meet per-slice SLOs with fewer resources.
limitation_or_critique: Magazine-style article whose evidence is illustrative rather than a systematic evaluation on a real core.

expected_title: Centralized and Federated Learning for Predictive VNF Autoscaling in Multi-Domain 5G Networks and Beyond
summary: Frames horizontal and vertical VNF autoscaling as forecasting the needed instance count from expected traffic, and compares centralised with federated deep-learning models across administrative domains.
method: deep-learning time-series forecasting; federated vs centralised training; Kubernetes orchestration prototype
key_result: Federated models give forecasting quality close to centralised ones while keeping domain data local, and the forecasts drive a working Kubernetes autoscaler.
limitation_or_critique: Targets generic MEC VNFs rather than 5G core control-plane NFs, and scaling quality is judged mostly by forecast error rather than end-to-end procedure KPIs.

expected_title: Residual Artifact Governance With ML-Enabled Garbage Collection Prediction in Kubernetes-Based 5G/6G Service-Based Architecture
summary: Proposes a non-intrusive master-agent add-on for a Kubernetes-hosted service-based core that predicts and bounds the build-up of leftover cluster artifacts which degrade observability and stability.
method: ML time-to-collapse predictor at a GC-master plus deterministic cleanup at per-NF GC-agents
data_or_testbed: Kubernetes-based SBA prototype under nominal and stress leak regimes
key_result: Periodic fractional cleanup keeps residual-artifact peaks bounded and the predictor gives early warning of collapse under both regimes.
limitation_or_critique: Addresses a narrow platform-hygiene failure mode in a prototype, without evidence on UE-facing core KPIs or operator-scale clusters.

expected_title: Demonstrating Per-UE Energy Consumption Monitoring Using Energy Information Function
summary: Demonstrates an end-to-end, 3GPP-aligned energy measurement chain in which an extended Energy Information Function exposes per-UE energy consumption to an Application Function.
method: prototype of the Rel-19 EIF with exposure to an AF that adapts IoT algorithms and data streams
key_result: Shows (qualitatively, as a demo) that an AF can monitor per-UE energy through the EIF and adapt its service behaviour accordingly.
limitation_or_critique: A short demo paper covering user-plane/IoT energy attribution only, with no control-plane NF energy or energy-aware NF selection.

expected_title: Zero-touch networks: Towards next-generation network automation
summary: Surveys zero-touch networks within the ETSI ZSM framework across optimisation, monitoring, energy and security, and adds an AutoML pipeline case study for 5G+ automation.
method: survey plus AutoML pipeline experiment (throughput prediction with drift adaptation)
key_result: Reports that the AutoML pipeline predicts application throughput more accurately than conventionally tuned ML and adapts to data drift.
limitation_or_critique: Broad ZSM survey not specific to the core; the experiment concerns throughput prediction rather than a closed loop acting on core NFs.

expected_title: The Agentic-AI Core: An AI-Empowered, Mission-Oriented Core Network for Next-Generation Mobile Telecommunications
summary: Proposes a mission-oriented 6G core in which autonomous network agents turn natural-language customer intents into workflows of network capabilities using a large network AI model.
method: architecture proposal: agents plus a telecom-tuned large network model composing capability workflows
key_result: Argues, through two use cases, that agent-composed workflows could make the core more agile and shorten standardisation cycles.
limitation_or_critique: Industrial vision with no quantitative evaluation of reliability, latency or safety of agent-generated procedures.

expected_title: A-Core: A Novel Framework of Agentic AI in the 6G Core Network
summary: Introduces A-Core, a framework that couples a network-wide core large model, generative network instances and role-specialised GenAI agents to create customised services in a 6G core.
method: multi-agent GenAI architecture with a core-network large model
key_result: A case study suggests (qualitatively) faster service creation, and the paper lists design and implementation issues for agentic cores.
limitation_or_critique: Workshop-level concept paper without measured results, safety mechanisms or alignment with 3GPP NF procedures.

expected_title: Towards Intent-Based Network Management: Large Language Models for Intent Extraction in 5G Core Networks
summary: Develops a custom LLM that extracts operator intents for 5G core management as a first step toward end-to-end intent-based networking.
key_result: Shows that a domain-tuned LLM can extract structured intents for core management and outlines integration steps for full intent-based automation.
limitation_or_critique: Stops at intent extraction, without mapping to the TS 28.312 intent model, feasibility checking or a closed loop on live NFs.

expected_title: Agentic GitOps: Multi-Step Operational Coordination for Intent-Driven 5G Networks
summary: Combines an LLM agent layer with declarative GitOps actuation, so that intents become verifiable commits coordinating multi-step reconfiguration of cloud-native 5G NFs via an MCP interface.
method: LLM agent + Model Context Protocol + GitOps desired-state reconciliation
key_result: Reaches a 78% success rate even with goal-only intents while cutting pre-encoded controller logic from 18 to 8 resolution steps.
limitation_or_critique: A single reconfiguration case study; failure modes of the remaining 22% and the latency against core timing budgets are not characterised.

expected_title: Type-Safe Decision Frameworks for Agentic 5G Control: A Theory-Driven Testbed Characterization of Where They Can Be Applied
summary: Characterises when agentic controllers of a 5G core can be trusted if every decision must come from a declared option set, using checkable predicates for timeliness, type conformance, certification cost and cardinality.
method: three typed-decision designs (hosted typed model, fine-tuned typed encoder, retrofitted LLM) with an act/escalate/abstain gate and conformal risk control
data_or_testbed: Open5GS/UERANSIM testbed with a closed core-policy loop
key_result: The fine-tuned typed encoder repeated its training answer for 98-99.5% of changed questions and its gate then acted wrongly on up to 80% of them, versus at most about 14% for the question-reading designs, which were slower or needed an 8B model.
limitation_or_critique: Recent single-group preprint on a small lab core; the decision classes are policy-loop choices rather than full multi-NF remediation.

expected_title: Autonomic Closed-Loop Service Management based on Interworking Multiple AI Models
summary: Defines a unified interface through which several AI models for self-monitoring, self-configuration and self-optimisation interwork to run closed-loop management of cloud-native network functions, including failure prediction.
method: multi-model closed loop (monitoring, configuration, optimisation) with predictive failure handling
key_result: The prototype builds network services automatically and keeps QoS of running services by reacting to past and predicted failures (qualitative).
limitation_or_critique: The abstract reports no quantitative results, and the CNFs are not shown to be 3GPP core NFs or tied to standard restoration procedures.

expected_title: Assurance and Conflict Detection in Intent-Based Networking: A Comprehensive Survey and Insights on Standards and Open-Source Tools
summary: Surveys how intent fulfilment is assured and how conflicts between intents are detected across the intent life cycle, with a review of standards and open-source tools.
key_result: Organises assurance (AI/ML and monitoring based) and conflict-detection techniques by life-cycle stage and identifies generalisation and scalability as open problems.
limitation_or_critique: Generic IBN scope, not specific to the 5G/6G core or to conflicts between agent-driven loops.
standards_link: TS 28.312; ETSI ZSM 011; IETF/IRTF NMRG intent RFCs

expected_title: A Feasibility-Shielded Agentic AI Framework for 6G Self-Healing Core Networks
summary: Proposes a cognitive-digital-twin agent for fault remediation in a 6G core whose LLM-proposed actions pass a deterministic feasibility shield and a short-horizon lookahead simulation before execution.
method: LLM agent on an OODA loop + knowledge base + deterministic feasibility shield + lookahead simulation of candidate actions
data_or_testbed: 3GPP-compliant 6G core simulator with injected link failures
key_result: Improves packet delivery ratio by about 39 percentage points during critical link failures over a no-intervention baseline.
limitation_or_critique: Simulator-only study against a weak no-action baseline, and the faults are link failures rather than NF or database failures.
found_via: manual (Crossref title search while recovering Ameur2026Agenticsurvey references; not a citation link)
